reviews.comment:
Las estación de servicio YPF está algo desactualizada, quedó chica para el caudal de gente que transita el ida y vuelta a la patagonia (uno de los principales caminos desde BA provincia). Pocos surtidores, baños chiquitos, lugar para estacionar de...sí, 5 o 6 autos!!?**"% nada! deberían remodelarla.
La atención de los muchachos playeros y de las chicas en el shop es muy buena. El hotel (que no utilicé) parece muy fachero.
Hay lugar para parar al aire libre si el clima lo permite.

(Translated by Google)
The YPF gas station is somewhat outdated and too small for the volume of people traveling to and from Patagonia (one of the main routes from Buenos Aires province). Few pumps, tiny restrooms, and parking for...yes, maybe 5 or 6 cars! It's practically useless! They should remodel it. The service from the attendants and the shop staff is very good. The hotel (which I didn't use) looks very nice. There's a place to stop outdoors if the weather permits.

reviews.comment:
Excelente posta para descansar y recargar combustible de ida o vuelta al sur evitando el tránsito del centro de Bahia Blanca.
Tiene un parque atrás con algunos árboles para tirarse en el suelo y unas mesas de cemento para comer algo afuera si te lo permite el clima. Los tostados y las empanadas son deliciosas y a un precio acorde.

(Translated by Google)
An excellent rest stop to refuel on your way south or back, avoiding the traffic in downtown Bahia Blanca.
It has a park in the back with some trees to relax on and cement tables for eating outside if the weather permits. The toasted sandwiches and empanadas are delicious and reasonably priced.

reviews.comment:
OJO! Ofrecen descuento por pago en efectivo, pero no es así: te descuentan 10 % por no emitir factura (eso es evasión....)
Protocolo COVID inexistente. El desayunador con las ventanas herméticamente cerradas. Suspender de alcohol, sin alcohol

Queda cómodo porque está sobre la ruta y se evita entrar al centro, pero muy desactualizados...

(Translated by Google)
BEWARE! They offer a discount for cash payments, but that's not the case: they deduct 10% for not issuing a receipt (that's tax evasion...). There's no COVID protocol in place. The breakfast area has its windows tightly closed. Alcohol is suspended, and there's no alcohol.

It's convenient because it's on the main road and avoids going into the city center, but they're very outdated...
